definition: A furry animal with four legs that barks. Lots of people keep dogs as pets.
example: The dog wagged its tail when we came home.

definition: A small furry animal with whiskers and a long tail that says miaow.
example: The cat curled up in a sunny spot.

definition: A very big grey animal with large floppy ears and a long nose called a trunk.
example: The elephant sprayed water with its trunk.

definition: A very tall animal with a long neck, long legs and patchy brown spots.
example: The giraffe ate leaves from the top of the tree.

definition: A sea animal with a soft, squishy body and eight long arms.
example: The octopus squeezed into a tiny gap between the rocks.

definition: An insect with four big wings that are often bright and colourful.
example: A butterfly landed on the purple flower.

definition: A small, wriggly creature that munches leaves and later turns into a butterfly or moth.
example: The hungry caterpillar ate a hole in the leaf.

definition: An animal that lived millions of years ago. Some dinosaurs were bigger than a house!
example: We saw a dinosaur skeleton at the museum.

definition: A black and white bird that cannot fly but is brilliant at swimming.
example: The penguin slid on its tummy across the ice.

definition: A bird with big round eyes that stays awake at night and sleeps in the day.
example: We heard an owl hooting in the dark.

definition: A small creature with eight legs that spins sticky webs to catch flies.
example: A spider made a web in the corner of the window.

definition: A buzzing insect with yellow and black stripes that makes honey.
example: The bee buzzed from flower to flower.

definition: A big fish with lots of sharp teeth and a fin on its back.
example: The shark swam slowly past the boat.

definition: A large, strong animal with four legs, hooves and a long tail. People can ride horses.
example: The horse galloped across the field.

definition: A small furry animal with long ears and a fluffy tail that hops.
example: The rabbit nibbled a carrot.

definition: A curved stripe of colours in the sky. You can see one when the sun shines through rain.
example: After the storm, a rainbow appeared over the hills.

definition: The loud rumbling, crashing noise you hear during a storm.
example: The thunder was so loud it made the windows rattle.

definition: A very bright flash of light that zigzags across the sky in a storm.
example: Lightning lit up the whole sky.

definition: A white or grey fluffy shape in the sky. Clouds are made of tiny drops of water.
example: That cloud looks like a sheep!

definition: Soft white flakes of frozen water that fall from the sky when it is very cold.
example: We built a snowman in the snow.

definition: A small pool of water on the ground, usually after it has rained.
example: I jumped in the puddle in my wellies.

definition: A mountain that can blast out hot melted rock, smoke and ash from the top.
example: Smoke was coming out of the volcano.

definition: A huge area of salty water. Oceans cover most of the Earth.
example: Whales and dolphins live in the ocean.

definition: A piece of land with water all the way around it.
example: The pirates sailed to a tiny island.

definition: A big area of land covered with lots and lots of trees.
example: We went for a walk in the forest.

definition: The big round thing that shines in the night sky. It travels around the Earth.
example: The moon was big and bright tonight.

definition: A huge round world that travels around a star. We live on planet Earth.
example: Saturn is the planet with rings around it.

definition: A tiny twinkling light in the night sky. It is really a giant ball of fire very far away.
example: I wished on the first star I saw.

definition: A tiny thing that a new plant can grow from.
example: We planted a sunflower seed in a pot.

definition: The colourful part of a plant. Flowers often smell nice.
example: She picked a yellow flower for her mum.

definition: A very tall plant with a wooden trunk, branches and leaves.
example: The squirrel ran up the tree.

definition: A machine shaped like a tube that blasts off into space.
example: Three, two, one… the rocket took off!

definition: A big, strong building with thick walls and towers, where kings and queens lived long ago.
example: The castle had a drawbridge and a moat.

definition: A make-believe monster from stories. Dragons have wings and can breathe fire.
example: The dragon guarded a pile of gold.

definition: A machine that can move and do jobs by itself.
example: The robot helped to tidy the room.

definition: A machine with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals round with your feet.
example: I rode my bicycle to the park.

definition: A cover on a stick that you hold over your head to keep dry when it rains.
example: Take your umbrella, it's raining!

definition: A place full of books that you can borrow, read and take back.
example: We chose three books at the library.

definition: A building where doctors and nurses look after people who are poorly or hurt.
example: My baby brother was born in the hospital.

definition: A piece of ground by a house where people grow grass, flowers or vegetables.
example: We grew tomatoes in the garden.

definition: Something built over a river or road so that people can get across.
example: We walked over the bridge and looked at the river.

definition: A long passage that goes under the ground or through a hill.
example: The train went into a dark tunnel.

definition: A machine that shows you what time it is.
example: The clock says it's time for bed.

definition: A round thing that turns so that cars, bikes and trains can roll along.
example: One wheel came off my toy car.

definition: A special piece of shiny glass where you can see yourself.
example: I pulled a funny face in the mirror.

definition: A piece of metal that pulls some other metal things towards it.
example: The magnet picked up all the paper clips.

definition: A drawing of a place that shows you where things are and how to get there.
example: We used a map to find the beach.

definition: Gold, jewels or other very special things, sometimes hidden away.
example: The pirates dug up a chest of treasure.

definition: Someone in stories who sails the seas and steals from other ships.
example: The pirate had a parrot on his shoulder.

definition: A round, crunchy fruit that is red, green or yellow.
example: I had an apple in my lunchbox.

definition: A long, curved fruit with a yellow skin that you peel off.
example: The monkey peeled a banana.

definition: Two slices of bread with food like cheese or jam in the middle.
example: I made a cheese sandwich for lunch.

definition: A flat, round bread baked with tomato, cheese and other toppings.
example: We cut the pizza into eight slices.

definition: The first meal of the day, that you eat in the morning.
example: I had porridge for breakfast.

definition: The day each year when you remember the day you were born.
example: On my birthday I had a cake with six candles.

definition: Someone you like, who likes you too, and who you enjoy spending time with.
example: My friend and I played tag at break time.

definition: The people who love you and look after you, like parents, carers, brothers, sisters and grandparents.
example: My whole family came to watch the show.

definition: A person whose job is to help people learn things, often at school.
example: Our teacher read us a story.

definition: A person whose job is to help people get better when they are poorly or hurt.
example: The doctor listened to my heart.

definition: The part at the end of your arm, with four fingers and a thumb.
example: Put your hand up if you know the answer.

definition: One of the hard white things in your mouth that you use to bite and chew.
example: My wobbly tooth fell out!

definition: The part inside your chest that pumps blood all around your body. You can feel it beating.
example: After running, my heart was beating fast.

definition: The part inside your head that you use to think, learn, remember and feel.
example: Your brain helps you solve puzzles.

definition: A dark shape on the ground or a wall, made when something blocks the light.
example: My shadow was really long in the evening sun.

definition: A new thought in your head about something you could do or make.
example: I had a great idea for a game!

definition: Something you ask when you want to find something out.
example: Can I ask a question?

definition: Something that only a few people know about, and that you keep to yourself.
example: Can you keep a secret?

definition: Something done wrong by accident. Everyone makes mistakes, and that's how we learn!
example: I made a mistake, so I rubbed it out and tried again.

definition: An exciting trip or experience where you do something new.
example: We went on an adventure to find the hidden waterfall.

definition: Feeling good and pleased, like when you are smiling or laughing.
example: I was happy when my friend came to play.

definition: Feeling unhappy, like you might want to cry.
example: He felt sad when his balloon floated away.

definition: Feeling very cross, because something seems unfair or has gone wrong.
example: She was angry when her tower was knocked over.

definition: Feeling afraid, like something bad might happen.
example: I was scared of the thunder.

definition: Doing something even though it feels scary or difficult.
example: She was brave and jumped into the deep end.

definition: Feeling very happy and full of energy because something good is going to happen.
example: I was so excited about the trip that I couldn't sleep.

definition: Feeling like you need to rest or sleep.
example: After the long walk, we were all tired.

definition: Feeling like you want or need to eat something.
example: I'm hungry! What's for tea?

definition: Feeling like you want or need a drink.
example: Playing football made me thirsty.

definition: Being friendly, gentle and helpful to other people.
example: It was kind of you to share your crayons.

definition: Soft and careful, so that you don't hurt anything or anyone.
example: Be gentle when you stroke the kitten.

definition: Feeling pleased about something good that you or someone else has done.
example: I felt proud when I finished my first book.

definition: Feeling sad because you are on your own and want someone to be with.
example: The new girl looked lonely, so we asked her to play.

definition: Funny and a bit daft, not serious.
example: Dad wore a silly hat to make us laugh.

definition: Wanting to know or find out about something.
example: The curious puppy sniffed the box.

definition: Feeling sudden shock or wonder because something happened that you didn't expect.
example: She was surprised to see a frog in the bath!

definition: Turned into ice, or gone very hard and stiff, because it got so cold.
example: The pond was frozen, so the ducks walked on it.

definition: Very warm. Hot things can burn you if you touch them.
example: Be careful, the soup is hot!

definition: Not warm at all, like ice or a winter's day.
example: Put your hat on, it's cold outside.

definition: A little bit hot, in a nice cosy way.
example: I snuggled up in my warm blanket.

definition: Covered in water or another liquid. Not dry.
example: My socks got wet in the rain.

definition: Not wet. Having no water on it or in it.
example: Hang the towel up so it gets dry.

definition: Large in size. Not small.
example: A whale is a big animal.

definition: Little in size. Not big.
example: A mouse is a small animal.

definition: Very, very small.
example: A tiny ant carried a crumb.

definition: Very, very big.
example: The dinosaur left a huge footprint.

definition: Moving or happening quickly.
example: The racing car was very fast.

definition: Taking a long time to move or do something. Not fast.
example: The tortoise was slow but it won the race.

definition: Making a lot of noise that is easy to hear.
example: The fire engine had a loud siren.

definition: Making very little noise, or no noise at all.
example: Be quiet, the baby is asleep.

definition: Squishy or smooth and nice to touch. Not hard.
example: My teddy is soft and cuddly.

definition: Firm and solid, so it doesn't squash when you press it. Also means difficult.
example: The rock was too hard to break.

definition: Weighing a lot, so it is difficult to lift.
example: The bag of shopping was heavy.

definition: Full of light, or a strong, shining colour.
example: The sun was very bright this morning.

definition: With little or no light, like at night.
example: It gets dark early in winter.

definition: Having nothing inside.
example: The biscuit tin was empty!

definition: Having no space left inside. Also how you feel after a big meal.
example: The glass was full to the top.

definition: Not dirty. Washed and fresh.
example: I put on a clean T-shirt.

definition: Covered in mud, dust or marks. Not clean.
example: My trainers were dirty after the muddy walk.

definition: Flat and even, with no bumps or rough bits.
example: The pebble felt smooth in my hand.

definition: Bumpy or scratchy to touch. Not smooth.
example: The bark of the tree was rough.

definition: Covered in something that sticks to things, like honey or glue.
example: My fingers were sticky after eating the ice lolly.

definition: Bright and reflecting light, like something polished.
example: I found a shiny coin on the pavement.

definition: Having a thin edge or point that can cut or prick things.
example: Be careful, the scissors are sharp.

definition: Shaped like a circle or a ball.
example: The plate was round.

definition: Long from bottom to top. Higher than most things.
example: My dad is very tall.

definition: Not long or not tall. Also means not lasting very long.
example: The puppy had short legs.

definition: Having lived or been around for a long time. Not new or young.
example: Grandad has an old car from when he was young.

definition: Just made or just bought, or something you haven't seen before.
example: I got new shoes for school.

definition: Not very old. Having been alive only a short time.
example: The young lambs played in the field.

definition: Very lovely to look at or listen to.
example: What a beautiful sunset!

definition: Tasting really, really good.
example: Granny's apple crumble is delicious.

definition: Likely to hurt you or cause harm. Not safe.
example: It's dangerous to play near the road.

definition: Impossible to see.
example: The wizard drank a potion and became invisible.

definition: To move very quickly on your feet.
example: I can run faster than my brother.

definition: To push yourself up off the ground with your legs.
example: The kangaroo can jump really high.

definition: To go up something using your hands and feet.
example: We climbed to the top of the climbing frame.

definition: To move through water using your arms and legs.
example: I can swim a whole length of the pool.

definition: To move through the air, like a bird or an aeroplane.
example: The birds fly south in the winter.

definition: To make a hole in the ground by moving soil or sand.
example: Let's dig a hole on the beach.

definition: To make something by putting pieces together.
example: We build towers out of blocks.

definition: To make happy sounds because something is funny.
example: The clown made everyone laugh.

definition: To have tears come out of your eyes, usually because you are sad or hurt.
example: The baby started to cry when she was hungry.

definition: To talk very, very quietly.
example: She whispered a secret in my ear.

definition: To say something very loudly.
example: We had to shout across the playground.

definition: To let someone else have or use some of what you have.
example: Let's share the biscuits so everyone has one.

definition: To pay attention so that you hear something.
example: Listen carefully to the story.

definition: To make a picture of something in your mind, even if it isn't real.
example: Imagine you could fly like a bird!

definition: To find something or find out about something for the first time.
example: We discovered a hidden path in the woods.

definition: To take something that belongs to someone else, and give it back later.
example: Can I borrow your pencil?

definition: To change from hard to runny because it gets warm, like ice turning into water.
example: My ice cream started to melt in the sun.

definition: To get so cold that water turns into ice. Also means to stay completely still.
example: The puddles freeze on winter nights.

definition: To get bigger or taller over time.
example: Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up.

definition: To look around a place you don't know, to find out what's there.
example: Let's explore the rock pools.

definition: To suddenly blow air out of your nose and mouth with a loud 'atchoo!'
example: The pepper made me sneeze.

definition: To shake or move from side to side in an unsteady way.
example: The jelly wobbled on the plate.

definition: To laugh in a silly, quiet way.
example: We couldn't stop giggling at the joke.

definition: To go or put something where nobody can see it or find it.
example: Let's hide behind the sofa!

definition: To look carefully for something.
example: We searched everywhere for the lost key.

definition: To keep something in your mind, or bring it back into your mind.
example: Remember to bring your PE kit tomorrow.

definition: To not remember something.
example: Don't forget your coat!

definition: To stay steady without falling over.
example: Can you balance on one foot?

definition: To make water fly about in drops.
example: The children splashed in the paddling pool.

definition: To say that you will definitely do something.
example: I promise I'll tidy my room after lunch.

definition: A word you use to give the reason for something.
example: I wore my coat because it was cold.

definition: Earlier than something else.
example: Wash your hands before you eat.

definition: Later than something else.
example: We played outside after school.

definition: Below something, or lower down than it.
example: The cat is hiding under the table.

definition: In the space in the middle of two things.
example: I sat between Mum and Dad.

definition: Every time, or all the time.
example: I always brush my teeth before bed.

definition: Not ever. Not even once.
example: I have never seen a real whale.

definition: Perhaps. It might happen, or it might not.
example: Maybe it will snow tomorrow.

definition: With each other, or at the same time.
example: Let's sing the song together.
